summary: 7 film announcements, 3 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: Drifter
film.talent: Kate Beckinsale, Dermot Mulroney, Robert Knepper, Sticky Fingaz
film.announcement: Action-thriller film with Kate Beckinsale, Dermot Mulroney, Robert Knepper and rapper Sticky Fingaz in the cast.

film.title: The Gallerist
film.announcement: MRC comedy film acquired by Roadside Attractions and Vertical for U.S. distribution.

film.title: Alien Boy
film.announcement: Sci-fi film starring Waleed Zuaiter and Sarah Gadon has wrapped filming with Echo Lake and Mongrel Media as partners.

film.title: Beatles Production
film.announcement: Sam Mendes' Beatles film production is heading to Abbey Road for filming.

film.title: Descendants: Hidden Heroes
film.announcement: Disney expands Descendants universe with new film following the children of sidekicks from Aladdin, The Emperor's New Groove and other classic films.

film.title: Grown Ups 3
film.announcement: Grown Ups 3 begins production with Adam Sandler reuniting with co-stars as confirmed by set photos.

film.title: Caroline Fletcher
film.announcement: Indie dramedy film with Southern Charm star Craig Conover set to star.

tv.title: Power Book III: Raising Kanan
tv.announcement: Series concludes after 5 seasons with the series finale wrapping up the story.

tv.title: The Traitors: India Season 2
tv.announcement: Indian version of The Traitors unveils trailer for season 2 featuring host Karan Johar and a 21-celebrity cast.

tv.title: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives
tv.announcement: Reality series receives 20-episode renewal for season 6 following the Taylor Frankie Paul drama.
